overview.title: Program Overview
overview.subtitle: A practical, build-first coaching cohort designed to take you from foundational concepts to working autonomous agent architectures.
paragraphs: Agentic AI Foundations is an intensive, small-group live coaching program that teaches the core principles, engineering frameworks, and practical implementation patterns needed to build autonomous AI systems.

Rather than treating AI as a static text prompt interface, this program treats AI as an autonomous decision engine capable of using external tools, interacting with APIs, executing multi-step task loops, and collaborating in multi-agent workflows.

Delivered live in cohorts of no more than 5 participants, each session focuses on direct hands-on implementation: writing code, configuring automated workflow nodes, connecting tools, and testing live agent behaviors with personal feedback from the instructor.

why_program.title: Why This Program
why_program.subtitle: A disciplined conceptual journey from basic prompting to autonomous orchestration.
why_program.lead_text: The purpose of this program is not to make exaggerated claims of turning you into an "AI expert in 30 hours." Its purpose is to give you the solid, grounded mental models and practical engineering skills required to design, build, and evaluate functional agentic systems.

columns.title: Clear Mental Models
columns.desc: Understand precisely where a simple prompt is enough, where a deterministic automation is superior, and where an autonomous agent provides true leverage.

columns.title: Practical Independence
columns.desc: Gain confidence connecting external tools, structuring JSON outputs, writing resilient Python handlers, and managing agent state without black-box confusion.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Clear answers to essential questions regarding cohort structure, technical prerequisites, and outcomes.

items.question: Is this live or self-paced?
items.answer: This is 100% live coaching. You meet in small-group sessions for instruction, collaborative exercises, and direct live coding rather than watching static pre-recorded videos.

items.question: How many people are in each cohort?
items.answer: Each cohort is strictly capped at a maximum of 5 participants to guarantee personalized feedback, live troubleshooting, and meaningful engagement.

items.question: How long is the program and what is the weekly commitment?
items.answer: The program spans 30 instructional and building hours delivered across approximately 2 months at roughly 5 hours per week.

items.question: Do I need prior Agentic AI experience?
items.answer: No prior experience with AI agents is required. The curriculum begins with fundamental generative AI and prompting mental models before building toward autonomous loops.

items.question: Do I need prior Python experience?
items.answer: Basic familiarity with code concepts is helpful, but Module 5 covers the exact subset of Python required for AI systems (variables, dictionaries, JSON, HTTP requests, and basic error handling).

items.question: Will we build actual AI agents?
items.answer: Yes. In Module 6 and Module 7, you construct functional agents with external tool calling, reflection loops, and autonomous execution cycles.

items.question: Will we learn n8n?
items.answer: Yes. Module 4 is dedicated to n8n fundamentals: configuring triggers, nodes, webhooks, and integrating AI decision points into operational workflows.

items.question: Will we learn LangChain or LangGraph?
items.answer: No. This Foundations program focuses on raw, transparent architectures in Python and n8n so you master how agents genuinely function without framework abstractions.

items.question: Will we build multi-agent systems?
items.answer: Yes. Module 8 covers foundational coordinator and specialist delegation patterns, culminating in the AI Research & Decision Assistant Capstone project.

items.question: Is cloud deployment or Kubernetes included?
items.answer: No. The curriculum is focused on core agent mechanics, local execution, and API integration rather than advanced cloud infrastructure or MLOps.

items.question: What happens after completing the program?
items.answer: You will have working codebases, functional automations, and the independent mental model needed to build production systems or pursue advanced framework specializations.

items.question: How do I join the next cohort?
items.answer: Use the consultation form on the Contact page to enquire. Because each cohort is capped at 5 seats, enrollment is confirmed on a rolling basis following a brief alignment discussion.
